title.zh: CPU 是怎么运行一个程序的
title.en: How a CPU Runs a Program

desc.zh: 你写的一行代码，最后怎么变成 CPU 里一拍一拍的动作？同一个程序，为什么换一种写法、换一颗 CPU，速度能差好几倍？从指令集这份合同讲起：RISC-V 的寄存器和六种指令格式、把一个循环手工翻译成机器码、单周期数据通路和它的关键路径、五级流水线、数据冒险与转发、分支的代价、性能铁律、x86 怎么在内部拆成小操作，以及 RVA23、Armv9.8、APX 这些 2026 年的前沿。每个模型都是真的：汇编器、指令解释器、逐拍的流水线模拟器。
desc.en: How does a line of code become clock-by-clock work inside a CPU, and why can the same program run several times faster with different code or a different CPU? Starting from the instruction set as a contract: RISC-V registers and its six instruction formats, hand-compiling a loop to machine code, the single-cycle datapath and its longest path, the five-stage pipeline, data hazards and forwarding, the cost of branches, the iron law of performance, how x86 splits instructions into micro-ops, and the 2026 frontier (RVA23, Armv9.8, APX). Every model is real: an assembler, an instruction interpreter and a cycle-by-cycle pipeline simulator.

title.zh: 指令集架构：软件和硬件之间的合同
title.en: The ISA: a contract between software and hardware

desc.zh: 指令集规定指令和它们的效果，不规定速度；x86、Arm、RISC-V 是三份合同，不是三颗芯片。
desc.en: An ISA fixes the instructions and their effects, not their speed; x86, Arm and RISC-V are three contracts, not three chips.

zh: x86 和 Arm 有什么区别
en: what is an instruction set architecture
how a CPU runs a program

title.zh: RISC-V 的寄存器和六种指令格式
title.en: RISC-V registers and the six instruction formats

desc.zh: RV32I 有 32 个寄存器、六种 32 位格式，寄存器编号永远在同样的位上；页面上可以把任意一条指令编码成机器码，或者反过来。
desc.en: RV32I has 32 registers and six 32-bit formats with register fields always in the same bits; encode any instruction to machine code on the page, or back.

zh: R 型 I 型 S 型 B 型

title.zh: 把一个循环翻译成机器码
title.en: Hand-compiling a loop to machine code

desc.zh: 同一行 C 有不同的翻译：下标、指针、展开三种写法每个元素 6、4、3 条指令。
desc.en: One line of C, three translations: indexing, a pointer and unrolling take 6, 4 and 3 instructions per element.

zh: C 代码怎么变成汇编
一行代码变成几条指令
en: how many instructions does a loop take

title.zh: 单周期数据通路和控制信号
title.en: The single-cycle datapath and its control signals

desc.zh: 一拍做完一条指令：PC、指令存储器、寄存器堆、ALU、数据存储器，由七根控制线决定哪些路接通。
desc.en: One instruction per clock: PC, instruction memory, register file, ALU and data memory, with seven control lines choosing the paths.

title.zh: 最慢的那条指令定了时钟
title.en: The slowest instruction sets the clock

desc.zh: 单周期的时钟要盖住 lw 的全程，其他指令白等；切成五段后每段按最慢的一段算。
desc.en: A single-cycle clock must cover the whole of lw, so other instructions wait; split into five stages, each stage runs at the pace of the slowest.

zh: 流水线为什么不能快五倍
en: why a five-stage pipeline is not five times faster

desc.zh: IF、ID、EX、MEM、WB 五段之间放流水线寄存器，五条指令同时在路上；每条不变快，吞吐量变大。
desc.en: Pipeline registers between IF, ID, EX, MEM and WB keep five instructions in flight; none gets faster, throughput rises.

en: why pipelining speeds up a CPU

title.en: Data hazards and the forwarding paths

desc.zh: 下一条要用上一条的结果时，从 EX/MEM 和 MEM/WB 把数递回 ALU；只剩取数后紧跟着用要停一拍，调度可以藏住它。
desc.en: When an instruction needs its predecessor's result, values go back to the ALU from EX/MEM and MEM/WB; only a use right after a load still waits a cycle, which scheduling can hide.

title.en: Control hazards: the cost of a branch

desc.zh: 分支在 EX 段才知道跳不跳，猜不跳猜错要冲掉两条；把比较提前到 ID 只冲一条，但可能多一拍数据停顿。
desc.en: A branch resolves in EX; predicting not-taken wrongly flushes two instructions; comparing in ID flushes one but can add a data stall.

desc.zh: 运行时间 = 指令数 × 每条指令平均几拍 × 每拍多长；写法、微架构、电路各管一项，三项相乘。
desc.en: Time = instructions × cycles per instruction × clock period; code, microarchitecture and circuits each own one factor, and they multiply.

zh: 指令数乘 CPI 乘时钟周期
en: is higher clock speed always faster
instructions times CPI times clock period

title.zh: CISC 与 RISC，x86 的微操作
title.en: CISC vs RISC and x86 micro-ops

desc.zh: x86 一条指令可以读内存、运算、写内存，长度可变；现代 x86 芯片在译码时把它拆成像 RISC 一样的微操作。
desc.en: One x86 instruction can load, compute and store, at variable length; modern x86 chips decode it into RISC-like micro-ops.
